info.name: Monster Raid Service (through Gateway)
info.description: Run in saved order against the reviewed shared stack. REST and user setup use gatewayUrl; internal service calls use only serviceToken through Gateway. Tokens and generated identifiers stay collection-scoped. Set runReplicaChecks=true and expectedReplicaCount=2 or 3 only after the configured replicas are healthy. Direct status checks use the per-replica URLs; WebSockets use the exact URL returned by ticket negotiation. Runner checks negotiation only; open the saved socket URL separately for fan-out. Raid lifecycle requires real Guild/Registry/Tamagotchi fixtures in live mode, or matching IDs for the configured mocks. Admin-only requests skip without the collection adminToken. Never export real tokens or ticket URLs to Git.
